text:
fran: opened a small PR to clarify structured-output guidance for function/tool calling and add a short migration note + tiny SDK snippet. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5129

isabel: thanks! can you include both: 1) a minimal direct call example, 2) an envelope example that carries metadata (we keep seeing customers ask about that). also a one-line shim for nullable arrays would be great.

tony: +1 on the shim. real-world tools sometimes return null or a single object. a 1-liner normalizer saves a lot of user pain.

fran: draft direct example in the PR:
```json
{"name":"get_profile","arguments":{"id":"u_901"}}
```
and compact envelope suggestion:
```json
{"call":{"name":"get_profile","arguments":{"id":"u_901"}},"meta":{"svc":"profiles","ver":"2025-09"}}
```

isabel: love the compact keys. please prefer `meta` (short) not `metadata` — docs style guide. add a one-sentence rationale: envelopes are recommended when you need provenance or confidence scores.

zara: please include guardrail guidance: recommend tolerating unknown fields for forward compatibility, show "additionalProperties": true in the schema snippet. say that strict failure for unknown fields is reserved for validated internal contracts only.

fran: added schema fragment in the draft and a short sentence: "Prefer tolerating extra fields (additionalProperties: true) to allow forward-compatible schema evolution."

tony: shim I recommend:
```js
const items = Array.isArray(res.items) ? res.items : (res.items ? [res.items] : []);
```
This covers null, single-object, and array cases.

isabel: can you also add a tiny SDK helper (<=7 lines) that calls parseStructured(resp, schema) and throws a deterministic error string so examples-tests can assert on it? use an explicit error message like: `StructuredParseError: missing required field 'id'`.

fran: added a 6-line helper that throws that exact string on the negative path. Pushed commit.

ci-bot: CI started for PR #5129 — lint: running, link-check: running, examples-tests: queued.

zara: minor nit: when showing the envelope example, include an optional `confidence` in meta to demonstrate numeric metadata.

fran: updated envelope with "confidence":0.92. Also included a short note: "Use numeric confidence only when model provides calibrated scores."

ci-bot: examples-tests failed — flaky assertion: some runtimes return error without quotes around the field name. Test expects single quotes.

isabel: adjust the helper to normalize error formatting: throw the exact string used by the examples-tests. don't try to infer runtime formatting. Keep docs deterministic.

fran: changed helper to throw `StructuredParseError: missing required field 'id'` exactly and added a tiny unit test asserting the message. Pushed.

ci-bot: rerun CI for PR #5129 — lint: pass, link-check: pass, examples-tests: pass.

tony: quick editorial pass from me: reword one sentence to avoid passive voice; tiny grammar fix.

zara: LGTM from me; added a small comment about linking to the runtime migration issue where we track the schema key rename.

fran: added a "Runtime note" paragraph: current runtime exposes schema under `structured_output_schema`; migration to `structured_schema` is tracked at runtime#782. Linked the issue.

isabel: thanks — once CI passes I'll do a final pass and merge. Also ping eng-runtime if we want a brief cross-reference in the release notes.

ci-bot: CI successful for PR #5129 — all checks passed.

isabel: quick final review done. merging now. :tada: docs site will rebuild in the next deploy window.

fran: thanks everyone — small PR but should cut down support tickets. :slightly_smiling_face:
